name: model-hub-det (the discovery window of the AI screen under stubs: the Apollia selection, the card and its variants, a too-large variant confirmed, only-what-fits, sort, format, the bounded search and the sort of publisher, offline, search by meaning, a restricted repository, and the downloads panel)
notes: Every answer of the Hub and of the registry is stubbed, so the book reaches no network: list_model_cards imitates CatalogueView (apollia-llm model_cards/fetch.rs), recommend_models the outcome of apollia_runtime::recommendation with its selection, get_embeddings_recommendation the answer of GET /api/v1/llm/embeddings, get_hardware_profile HardwareResponse (Apple Silicon, 21.3 GB, so MLX is offered), get_hf_model HfModelCard with its ModelVariant list (apollia-llm hf_registry.rs, recommend/variants.rs), search_hf_models BoundedPage with FoundModel and GeneratedCard (hf_registry/bounded.rs, generated.rs). They drift if those types change.

start_variant_download is stubbed to an id and never reaches the download manager: no file is written. The progress the backend would emit is delivered by emitEvent on model-download-progress (apollia_llm::DownloadProgress), which is what puts the row in the downloads panel; cancel_model_download is stubbed for the same reason. A real download from the window, followed and cancelled from the panel, is a gesture on a machine with a network.

The restricted repository is played with get_hf_token stubbed to null: the download is refused before any call, the window closes and the settings open on General. With a stored token the shell adds it itself (commands/hf_token.rs passed_or_stored).
ai-discover-card-copy is clicked for the gesture only: the clipboard of the webview may refuse outside a user activation, and either toast is acceptable.
The download button offline is asserted present with its reason beside it (ai-discover-status); it is disabled, so it is not clicked.
